facility.name: Smart Ducklings Daycare
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Transportation to/from School

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 1630 GOLIAD RD, SAN ANTONIO, TX, 78223

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that the van driver was not using the attendance sheet and did not know what children they were responsible for.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The director did not implement the plan set forth by the ownership to transport the correct children to the daycare and failed to report the incident to Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: During the course of the investigation, it was determined that the operation did not report picking up the wrong child from school to Child Care Regulation (CCR).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: During the inspection, a strong odor consistent with rodents was detected inside the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children: The toddler and infant classrooms were over  ratio. Note: This was corrected at inspection when children were moved to other classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maximum Group Size 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1609)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: There are two infants in the Infant room that do not have monthly feeding schedules.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: During inspection it was observed that the latch on the fence was not secured approrpiately, creating a safety concern, a child can open the gate.    During inspection a riding toy and a play car were observed broken.    Note:  The broken toys were removed from the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: The infant room did not have an updated infant feeding instructions for one infant.  The instructions was last updated in February 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The smoke detector is not being tested monthly as required.  The smoke detector was last tested 1/12/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment: Director did not have a current training in prevention, recognition, and reporting of child abuse and neglect.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training -Required 1 hour in prevention, recognition and reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1311(c))

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: The carbon monoxide is not being tested monthly.  The carbon monoxide was tested 1/12/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: It was observed that caregiver did not sanitize the changing table after changing a child's diaper.      Note:  Corrected when caregiver sanitized the changing table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The fire extinguishers are not being inspected monthly.  The fire extinguisher was last inspected by staff on 1/12/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle: The center bus did not have an Electronic Child Safety Alarm installed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - is equipped in each vehicle (26 TAC §746.5625(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Two of the fire extinguishers in the center van/bus and fire extingusihers through out the center have not been serviced.  The fire extinguishers were last serviced February 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child's file did not have an updated immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Three staff members had CPR training that was taken online, therefore does not adhere with the guidelines for American Heart Association.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: One toddler was sitting in the toddler table and was not strapped in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months: Director did not have current training in SIDS and shaken baby syndrome.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training - Caring for children under 24 months (26 TAC §746.1311(d))

occurrences.finding: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually: Director and two staff members did not have a current training in transportation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Transportation Safety Training -Director and Employee Complete 2 Hours Annually (26 TAC §746.1316(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Caregver in the two year room indicated she had 11 children in care, and after counting it was noted that caregiver had 10 children in care.       Caregver in the toddler room indicated she had 10 children in care, and after counting it was noted that caregiver had 11 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outline Daily Activities: Three classrooms did not have an activity plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outline Daily Activities (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Fire drills are not being conducted monthly.  The last fire drill was conducted on 1/12/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The small playground had over grown grass along the fence and by the stationary equipment.    Two nap mats in the prek room were observed torn from the edges, exposing the foam.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities: During inspection staff stated that a 2 year old child does not have outdoor time, and the child stays inside with another group due to parents request, and there is no doctor note in file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play Opportunities (26 TAC §746.2206(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During inspection it was observed that a 3 year old child was in the restroom located in hallway, while caregiver went into another classroom, therefore child was left unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation did not report the number of employees who ceased employment in 2023 by the required date 1.15.24.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: The caregiver in the school-age classroom stated there were ten children in care when there were 14 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: A menu was not posted at the time of inspection.    NOTE: This was corrected when it was posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Notify Parents of Change in Operational Policy or Enrollment Agreement: Based on the interviews conducted with administration changes to the policy were made without notifying the parents.     NOTE: Parent signed notifications were provided.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Notify Parents of Change in Operational Policy or Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §746.505(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: During the course of this investigation, it was determined the operation did not report to licensing after being notified on 10.16.23 by the parent by phone and through the Bright wheel message stating the child received medical attention after an injury at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Must Use for Each Child in When Transporting and be Properly Installed: One seatbelt in van #2 that is located on the first row near the window behind the driver's seat was observed broken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Must Use for Each Child in When Transporting and be Properly Installed (26 TAC §746.5607(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policy did not specify the following;   -Benefits of physical activity and outdoor play   -Duration of physical activity at your operation, both indoor and outdoor  Type of physical activity (structured and unstructured) that children may engage in at your operation.  -Each setting in which your physical activity program will take place.  -Recommended clothing and footwear that will allow a child to participate freely and safely in physical activities and  -The criteria you will use to determine when extreme weather conditions pose a significant health risk that prohibits or limits outdoor play and  -A plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: Two of the fire extinguishers in two of the van's being used were last serviced in 2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: One of the ten staff files had an expired CPR/First aid cared of 7.7.23.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics: One of the ten staff were missing the following training:  Safety First Awareness
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Remaining training hour topics (26 TAC §746.1309(f))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: One of the ten children didn't have an immunization record when reviewing on files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: One of the table booster chairs in classroom 7A was observed missing a fasten safety strap while a child was sitting it.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection as a safety strap was installed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: A trashcan without a lid was observed in the classroom 2B with diapers exposed.      TA: This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: No documented of the smoke detector, fire extinguisher and carbon monoxide for the month of January 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans: The operational policy did not specify the Emergency Preparedness plan.   In addition to how the infants will be transported.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plans (26 TAC §746.501(a)(24))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employees Required: At the time of the inspection six classrooms were observed with one caregiver in each as only one staff was present in the building which makes them two staff short present in the building.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employees Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: In the dark orange classroom, there was 6 infants (14-17 months) with one caregiver as the children were napping, resulting in being out of ratio by one.    NOTE: This was corrected when another caregiver stepped in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups: A 2-year-old child in room 2A was observed walking with a baby bottle.    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: One of the four cribs in the classroom 8A was observed with a loose crib sheet.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: An 8-month-old child was observed in the crib lying awake holding and drinking out of a baby bottle. In addition to another child awake wearing a baby bib while in the crib.      NOTE: This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: In classroom 2A a 12-month-old was observed with a 3-year-old during naptime.     NOTE: This was corrected.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: One of six personnel folders did not have the required employment affadavit available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- signed dated statement that employee attended abuse/neglect training: Two of six personnel records did not have the required abuse/neglect training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License (26 TAC §746.901(10))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: Two of ten children's records reviewed were missing the required information regarding to whom the children may be released.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: In the toddler room, there were thirteen children with an age group of two years. There was one caregiver. For this age group, a maximum of eleven children are allowed for one caregiver, Therefore, the classroom was out of ratio.     This was corrected when another caregiver arrived.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: Three out of six personnel folders did not have the required proof of educational requirements available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three of ten children's records reviewed were missing the required Healthcare Statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification: One of six personnel folders did not have the required copy of photo identification.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: One out of ten children's folders reviewed was missing the required healthcare provider's information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))
